title: Interrupt stale realtime Attempts on startup

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Realtime startup recovery tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/promo/test_realtime_startup_recovery.py

verify.summary: Compacted retained final functional PASS. Current task status is done.
Compacted final lifecycle closure: current task status is done.

evidence_required: FT-004-AC-008 RED: realtime startup does not close persisted accepted/searching Attempts; GREEN: startup atomically transitions every pre-restart accepted or searching row to interrupted before readiness, creates no session, invokes no inference/replay and cannot accept a late publication, while terminal rows stay unchanged and one fresh post-start request can proceed; decisive comparison: before/after Attempt/session rows and zero-call trace across both stale states; artifact: restart proof under .tasks/TASK-074-T3-FT-004-W1/.
purpose: Make realtime process restart truthfully terminate unfinished durable Attempts without persisting proposal work or replaying inference.
success_outcome: Before realtime readiness opens, every stale accepted/searching Attempt is terminal interrupted with no result/session or inference replay; terminal history is preserved and later work requires a fresh request.
anti_goals: Do not persist crop bytes, resume queries or create a durable replay queue.
Do not implement singleton/deadline orchestration or result publication.
Do not rewrite existing terminal Attempt outcomes.

forbidden_scope: Processing inference/search implementation and proposal-byte persistence
Result-session creation, QR behavior and FT-005 display state
Operator/default Attempt rows outside the uniquely identified probe set
stop_conditions: Startup cannot close stale owner rows before reporting readiness.
Recovery would require durable proposal replay or a new queue/lifecycle.
The transition cannot prevent a late result/session publication.

constraints: Invoke recovery from the realtime lifecycle before ready=true and before any fresh admission.
Use unique task-owned stale Attempt rows for accepted and searching, record initial/terminal state and clean only task fixtures.
A repeated recovery run is safe and leaves already terminal rows unchanged.
invariants: Reference work is not durable and is never replayed after restart.
Interrupted Attempts have no result session and cannot be overwritten by a late worker return.
Only a fresh capture/request may begin post-restart processing.
verification_targets: Accepted and searching restart fixtures prove interrupted transitions, no session and zero replay calls.
Idempotent rerun and fresh-request fixtures prove terminal preservation and post-start recovery.
